research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: DriveWealth is researching methods for executing fractional-based buy or sell orders, as described in 'How Fractional Share Orders are Executed.' The abstract details a process where a processing unit receives a fractional share component of an order, queues it, and manages execution, including notional-based buy orders. This work highlights DriveWealth’s focus on developing systems for efficient handling and processing of fractional share transactions.

overview_description.description:
DriveWealth, the global fintech investment rail and pioneer of fractional equities trading, is a visionary technology company that empowers more than 100 partners around the world to engage
their customers by placing the markets in the palm of their hands. We believe the future is fractional, transactional, and mobile. Every mobile device should be a gateway to accessing
investing and savings products, services, advice, and assistance for global citizens of all ages, wealth stages, and levels of financial expertise. DriveWealth’s consultative support and cloud based, modern technology platform allow partners to seamlessly offer branded investing experiences to drive customer acquisition, loyalty, retention, and revenue growth.

about_short_description.short_description: DriveWealth is a visionary technology company that empowers more than 100 partners around the world.

product.name: Brokerage-as-a-Service
product.description: An API-based brokerage infrastructure platform that enables businesses to offer account opening, funding, securities trading, custody, statements, and tax reporting to their customers.

product.name: Embedded Investing
product.description: A service that lets companies integrate investing and trading capabilities into their existing mobile or digital products through DriveWealth’s brokerage technology and APIs.

product.name: Full Service Brokerage
product.description: A brokerage service that combines technology, securities trading, custody, account operations, and related investment infrastructure for businesses serving retail or institutional customers.

product.name: Execution Services
product.description: Institutional trading infrastructure for order routing, clearing, custody, stock loan, liquidity access, and execution of securities transactions.

product.name: DriveWealth APIs and Developer Platform
product.description: A developer platform and API toolkit for building investment workflows, including customer creation, trading-account setup, order placement, order retrieval, funding, and account operations.

product.name: Investment Product Access
product.description: Brokerage access to U.S. equities, ETFs, OTC securities, mutual funds, fixed income, and options, including fractional trading for eligible securities.
